# knowledge.KnowledgeDocument

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A document indexed in the knowledge base; agents cite its chunks when answering.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `knowledge.KnowledgeDocument` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.knowledge.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contentHash` | yes | `none` | SHA-256 of the extracted text; unchanged content is not re-indexed. |  |
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the document was registered (UTC). |  |
| `createdBy` | yes | `personal` | Uid of the user who added it; null for platform content. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Document id (uuidv7). |  |
| `mimeType` | yes | `none` | Media type of the original content. |  |

| `source` | yes | `none` | Where the content came from. |  |
| `sourceRef` | yes | `none` | File id, URL, contract id or module doc path; unique per tenant and source. |  |
| `sourceUrl` | yes | `none` | Public URL of the source, when there is one. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | Indexing status. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Owning organization, or _platform for shared platform content. |  |
| `title` | yes | `personal` | Document title shown in citations. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the document last changed (UTC). |  |
